motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving a Property Tax Increase above the Certified Tax Rate for Fiscal Year 20226 -2027. Mayor Gray read the Proposed Property Tax Impact Schedule. The City Council discussed the proposed property tax increase , including concerns raised by citizens, the reason for the proposed increase and the use of additional funds.
motions.motion: Councilmember Whiting moved to adopt a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, to approve and adopt a property tax rate of 0.001500 for Fiscal Year 2026 -2027. This rate exceeds the certified tax rate of 0.000530 and will result in an increase in the City’s ad valorem property tax budgeted revenue of approximately $5,591,594.00 or 183.02% above the City’s p roperty tax budgeted revenue for the prior year, exclusive of new growth. Councilmember Wright seconded the motion.
